title: Mixdown and gain staging
goal: Balance the parts so the kick leads, nothing clips, and the bass ducks under the kick.
explain: Every stacked part adds up, so set levels with gain per part: kick near 1, bass around 0.5, chords and leads 0.2 to 0.35, noise and FX lower still. A high-pass on the chords (hpf) clears the low end for the kick and bass. Put the bass on its own orbit and let the kick duck it: duckorbit(2) on the kick lowers everything on orbit 2 each time it hits, a built-in sidechain. If the master sounds harsh, turn parts down rather than everything up.
try_prompt: Do a mixdown: set each part's gain so the kick leads, high-pass the chords, and sidechain the bass to the kick with duckorbit.
